job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer with 5+yrs exp to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. The role focuses on building RAG pipelines, Agentic AI systems, and scalable AI applications on the Azure ecosystem.




The ideal candidate should have strong backend engineering expertise combined with hands-on experience in LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and cloud-native deployments.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs and vector databases
Build and implement Agentic AI systems / multi-agent workflows (Lang Graph, MS Agentic Framework, etc.)
Develop scalable backend APIs (REST / Fast API) for AI-powered applications
Develop and deploy AI-powered web applications / copilots / agents
Build data ingestion, embedding, and vector search pipelines
Work with Azure ecosystem services (Azure OpenAI, ADLS, AKS, Functions, etc.)
Deploy AI workloads using Kubernetes (AKS) and containerization (Docker)
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications and external APIs
Ensure performance tuning, scalability, and reliability of AI systems
Follow best practices for Responsible AI, security, and governance



Required Skills:

Core AI & GenAI

Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architecture, and embeddings
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks:
Lang Graph / MS Agentic Framework / similar
Experience building multi-agent systems and AI copilots

Programming & Backend

Strong expertise in Python
Experience with:
Fast API / Flask / REST APIs
Microservices architecture

Cloud & Platform

Strong experience with Azure Ecosystem
Azure OpenAI
Azure Functions / App Services
Azure Data Services
Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and containerization (Docker)

Application Development

Experience building:
Web APIs
AI-enabled web applications

Data & AI Pipeline

Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, etc.)
Data ingestion and document processing pipelines
Knowledge of embeddings and semantic search

Good to Have

Experience with:
MCP / Model Context Protocol
Multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Crew AI, AutoGen)
Exposure to:
Copilot / AI Assistant development
Cowork/Droid-based agent ecosystems
Knowledge of:
Graph RAG / Knowledge Graphs
Experience with:
CI/CD, MLOps, and monitoring tools

Preferred Certifications

Azure AI / Azure Data / Cloud certifications
GenAI / LLM-related certifications




Looking for short Notice joiners, if interested, Pls share your resume to Pavan.vadge@techmahindra.com
